resources.string: Free compute comes from community members. They can see your task and screen, including chat and banking apps you ask it to open. If you prefer, use your own model. Content is encrypted and relayed by the Tadolio platform. You still have to trust the platform because in theory it could swap the encryption keys and read it. Free users earn no coins. Choosing a provider means you agree to be served by the provider shown.
Community service unavailable. Check the platform or provider qualification.
Some miners use metered cloud APIs; content passes through the named company.
AI calls are unavailable with community compute. Select your own key or account to use calls.
